motivation: Test whether decoder-neighbor cross-sample consistency provides a causal label-free signal for low-dimensional semantic consolidation before adding a learned routing module.

source.paper: C2R: Cross-sample Consistency Regularization Mitigates Feature Splitting and Absorption in Sparse Autoencoders

training_data.policy: read-only; metadata manifest must be identical before and after training
training_data.activation_source: same L22 activation cache used by existing baselines

wrong_control.definition: Cyclically shift the selected activation-norm vector by a nonzero step-dependent offset while preserving its exact multiset; retain the same decoder-neighbor geometry.

gate.pass_action: Develop the parameterized C2R consistency router with an exact same-parameter control suite.
gate.fail_action: Stop the C2R family before adding a learned module; do not run full7.
